summary.text: Gail Armstrong is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 49 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has been the House minority leader since January 21, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Armstrong's professional experience includes owning TLC Plumbing and serving as president of Pro-Fab, Inc.

In the 2025-2026 legislative session she was assigned to the Rules and Order of Business Committee and the Transportation, Public Works & Capital Improvements Committee, and in 2023-2024 she was the ranking member of the Appropriations and Finance Committee.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, with no opposition on the ballot.
